concerns.text: Task T012 cites a URL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/numenta/NAB/master/data/realKnownCause/...' for the American Gut Project (AGP). This is a semantic weakening of FR-001 and Constitution Principle VI, which mandate data from the 'American Gut Project repository'. The Numenta NAB dataset is unrelated to AGP. This task will fail to satisfy the FR if executed as written.

Task T014 implements 'Exclusion OR Impute' for missing demographics. While the Spec Edge Cases allow this, the task description lacks the mandatory 'documented flag' requirement for imputation specified in the Spec ('impute using median value with a documented flag'). Without this flag, the deliverable falls short of the Spec's acceptance criteria for data hygiene and traceability.

Task T022 selects the 'Top 20 Taxa' based on mean relative abundance. The Spec (FR-006) requires correlation on these 20 taxa, but FR-009 requires 'collinearity diagnostics when multiple taxa predictors are tested simultaneously'. The task list separates T022 (selection) and T023 (VIF diagnostics) but does not explicitly mandate that the VIF diagnostics in T023 must be performed *on the specific set of 20 taxa selected in T022*. This creates a risk of the diagnostics being run on a different set (e.g., all taxa or PCoA axes as suggested in the Plan), violating the semantic intent of FR-009 in the context of FR-006.

Task T041 validates SC-001 by logging the count but explicitly states 'Do not assert pass/fail'. The Spec (US-1 Acceptance Scenario 3) and Edge Cases mandate a hard exit (code 1) if valid strata < 5. T014 implements this exit, but T041's validation step is decoupled from the enforcement logic. If T014 is bypassed or modified, T041 will not catch the violation. The task should enforce the SC-001 threshold as a hard gate or explicitly link to the T014 exit logic to ensure the SC is preserved.
